prompt: We're a social media platform considering adding a feature that shows users how their post engagement compares to their own historical average and to similar users — a 'performance dashboard' to help creators understand their reach. Run the Ethics Frame and Ethics Gauge (enter at the Evaluate phase — we already have impact data from user research). Key concerns raised in our research: comparison anxiety in younger users, positive creator motivation effects, potential for metric-chasing behavior, and unequal algorithmic reach across demographic groups.
assertions: Output contains an Ethics Frame section
Output contains an Ethics Gauge section
Output does NOT contain a Future Story section (correct partial-chain entry at Evaluate phase)
Comparison anxiety in younger users is explicitly addressed
Unequal algorithmic reach across demographic groups is addressed
The fairness analysis mentions algorithmically disadvantaged groups or demographic inequity
At least one concrete design recommendation or design change is proposed
The Ethics Gauge assesses at least one dimension as a concern, risk, or hot spot
